claims: The 2026 NYC Half Marathon is on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 NYC Half Marathon features a 30,000+ runner field.
Road closures for the 2026 NYC Half Marathon in Brooklyn and Manhattan start around 12:00 a.m. and reopen by 2:00 p.m.
Eastern Parkway (Flatbush Ave to Franklin Ave) in Brooklyn will be closed 12:00 a.m. – 12:30 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Washington Ave (Eastern Pkwy to Carroll St) in Brooklyn will be closed 12:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Flatbush Ave (Empire Blvd to Grand Army Plaza) in Brooklyn will be closed 12:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Brooklyn Bridge (Manhattan-bound) will be closed 4:00 a.m. – 11:30 a.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Manhattan-bound lanes on Brooklyn Bridge will be closed 4:00 a.m. – 11:30 a.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Water St, parts of FDR Drive, 42nd St, Seventh Ave in Manhattan expect closures between 6:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
West Drive near 72nd Street in Central Park Finish Area will be closed until roughly 1:30 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Prospect Park/Grand Army Plaza is an area to avoid 5:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Brooklyn Bridge/Downtown Brooklyn is an area to avoid 6:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Midtown Manhattan/Times Square is an area to avoid 7:00 a.m. - 1:00 p.m. on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
